examples.japanese: {室温|しつおん}は25{度|ど}に{設定|せってい}してある。
examples.english: The room temperature is set to 25 degrees.

examples.japanese: バターを{室温|しつおん}に{戻|もど}してから{使|つか}ってください。
examples.english: Please bring the butter to room temperature before using it.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}は{室温|しつおん}が{下|さ}がりやすいので、{断熱|だんねつ}{対策|たいさく}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: In winter, room temperature tends to drop, so insulation measures are important.

notes:
The temperature inside a room or enclosed space. Used in everyday contexts such as cooking instructions and home comfort, as well as scientific contexts where experiments are conducted at room temperature (typically around 20-25°C).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {室温|しつおん}に{戻|もど}す: bring to room temperature
- {室温|しつおん}で{保存|ほぞん}する: store at room temperature
- {室温|しつおん}を{調整|ちょうせい}する: adjust the room temperature
- {室温|しつおん}{管理|かんり}: room temperature management

RELATED WORDS:
- {気温|きおん}: air temperature — outdoor temperature
- {体温|たいおん}: body temperature
- {水温|すいおん}: water temperature
